<thought>From the ¹H NMR spectrum we see four distinct signals (at 3.83 ppm, 7.49 ppm, 7.66 ppm, and 8.39 ppm). Each signal corresponds to a unique hydrogen environment, regardless of how many hydrogens contribute to that signal. Therefore, the compound has four chemically equivalent hydrogen types.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
